introParagraphs.pt-PT: Uma boa formação deve ajudar a compreender um tema e a saber o que fazer com essa informação. Por isso, trabalhamos exemplos, perguntas e situações próximas da realidade de quem participa.
introParagraphs.en:
I have been teaching for over a decade: in Brazil, and in English at LUNEX in Luxembourg. I learned that good training doesn't just unload theory: it starts from the audience's reality and delivers practical tools they can apply immediately.

I design tailored courses, workshops, and training programmes for universities, corporations, municipalities, and organisations, combining research rigour with pedagogical clarity.
